## Question

Do independently defined Graminoid status and Woodiness explain response structure?

## Dataset and sample size

Both predictors use the complete 1,604-effect, 526-species downstream universe; group coverage is shown below.

## Exact model specification

Each predictor is fitted separately as climate-only `M0`, additive-status `M1`, and full status-by-`T_z * P_z * W_z` interaction model.

## Assumptions

Graminoid and Woodiness assignments remain independent binary variables and
share the exact ordered `V_auc`. TNRS-derived family rows supply 525 retained
taxa; the shared downstream override ledger augments the active functional
target with the validated non-graminoid/non-woody assignment for *Viola
palustris*.

## Convergence and covariance diagnostics

Branch-specific ML, CR1, assignment, source-coverage, and observed-support checks are shown below.

## Main numerical results

```{r}
tables <- targets::tar_read(functional_model_tables_526)
mask <- targets::tar_read(woodiness_support_mask_specification)
mask_audit <- targets::tar_read(woodiness_support_mask_audit)
woodiness_figure_file <- targets::tar_read(woodiness_figure_file)
coverage <- targets::tar_read(functional_climate_coverage_526)
assignment_gate <- targets::tar_read(functional_species_equivalence)
source_audit <- targets::tar_read(functional_source_coverage_audit)
fit_gate <- targets::tar_read(functional_model_fit_equivalence)
comparison_gate <- targets::tar_read(functional_model_comparisons_equivalence)
cr1_gate <- targets::tar_read(functional_model_CR1_equivalence)
knitr::kable(tables$fit_statistics)
knitr::kable(tables$comparisons)
knitr::kable(tables$CR1)
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(mask[c("status", "needs_group_specific_observed_climate_support_mask", "model_refit_permitted")]))
knitr::kable(coverage)
knitr::kable(mask_audit)
knitr::kable(assignment_gate)
knitr::kable(source_audit)
knitr::kable(dplyr::bind_rows(fit_gate, comparison_gate, cr1_gate))
knitr::include_graphics(woodiness_figure_file, rel_path = FALSE)
```

## Interpretation boundary

The Woodiness support mask is calculated independently within the observed climate support of each group. It is a plotting-only refinement and cannot change the fitted model.

## Canonical objects

`functional_species_526`, `graminoid_model_sequence_526`,
`woodiness_model_sequence_526`, `woodiness_support_mask`, and
`woodiness_figure_file`.

## PASS/FAIL

Assignments, source coverage, model tables, CR1 rows, and group-specific support construction must pass.
